analysis.title: GS Crypto: Weekly Recap
key_insights: Crypto extended its decline through the first week of November. Month to date BTC is -3.82%, ETH -6.21%, SOL -10.3%, XRP -12.3% and HYPE -15.8% (HYPE is still +193% year to date), per Bloomberg.

BTC briefly reclaimed $80k midweek, then reversed lower the next day. It traded broadly in tandem with equities and unwound the post-election relief rally as markets reassessed the AI trade and the consequences of the Blue wave (GIR).

On Monday 9 November SPX rose 2.35% and NDX rose 3.40%, but BTC and other majors did not participate. BTC stayed near $74.6k, just above its 200-day moving average, which it broke above in August 2026.

BTC has held above its 200-day moving average for 83 days and is tracking toward a 90-day return of 8%. In three prior reclaims since 2015 after sustained downtrends (July 2015, April 2019, January 2023), 180-day forward returns ranged from 53% to 61%, averaging 57%. The desk notes the sample is limited.

US spot BTC ETFs had about $1.3b of net outflows last week. Wednesday's $74.6m inflow was the only positive session. Including $200m of outflows yesterday, year-to-date net flows are about -$1bn, after turning positive in late September.
US spot ETH ETFs had $365m of net outflows last week. Including $184m of outflows yesterday, year-to-date net flows are about -$590m, after turning positive in late August.

BTC perpetual futures funding fell from about 10% annualized to about 5.5%, so leveraged bullish exposure has moderated. The premium of perpetual over spot is still positive, so aggregate positioning still leans to the upside.

Liquidations: the 4 November relief rally liquidated $310m of BTC shorts. The reversal the next day liquidated $294m of longs, and another $222m of longs were liquidated on Sunday 8 November (Coinglass).
BTC 25-delta risk reversals have moved lower with spot. Put premium is rebuilding toward the levels seen through much of the year before the August inflection.
crypto_views: BTC is trading in tandem with equities on the downside but did not join the 9 November equity rebound, holding near $74.6k just above the 200DMA.
BTC has held above the 200DMA for 83 days. Past reclaims after sustained downtrends (2015, 2019, 2023) show an average 180-day forward return of 57%, from a limited sample.
Spot BTC ETF year-to-date flows are about -$1bn and spot ETH ETF flows are about -$590m, both back in negative territory after turning positive (BTC late September, ETH late August).
Month-to-date moves: BTC -3.82%, ETH -6.21%, SOL -10.3%, XRP -12.3%, HYPE -15.8% (HYPE +193% YTD).
risk_factors: Continued ETF outflows could extend the negative year-to-date flow totals.
BTC is only just above its 200-day moving average and did not join the equity rebound.
The historical 200DMA-reclaim sample is only three instances, which limits its reliability.
Options are growing more defensive as put premium rebuilds.
charts_described: Figure 1 table lists BTC returns after 200DMA reclaims: July 2015 (347 days below, 180d +61%), April 2019 (330 days, +56%), January 2023 (381 days, +53%), average +57%. The August 2026 reclaim followed 289 days below the 200DMA, with a 30d return of 17% and 83 days elapsed at an 8% 90d return.
vol_and_positioning: BTC perpetual funding fell from about 10% to about 5.5% annualized. The perp premium to spot is still positive, so positioning still leans to the upside.
Long liquidations of $294m on 5 November and $222m on 8 November followed $310m of short liquidations on 4 November.
BTC 25-delta risk reversals moved lower alongside spot, and put premium is rebuilding toward levels seen before August.
geopolitical: Post-election 'Blue wave' consequences and the AI trade are cited as the drivers of the reassessment that unwound the relief rally.

tension_points.bull_case: BTC has held above its 200DMA for 83 days. Past reclaims after sustained downtrends (2015, 2019, 2023) showed 180-day forward returns of 53% to 61%, averaging 57%. Funding is still positive, so positioning leans to the upside.
tension_points.bear_case: BTC did not join the 9 November equity rebound and sits just above the 200DMA at about $74.6k. Spot ETF flows are negative year to date, and put premium in options is rebuilding.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A break back below the 200-day moving average, which BTC sits just above at about $74.6k.
